claims: Portugal defeated the USMNT 2-0 on March 31, 2026.
The match was an international friendly.
The match took place at Mercedes-Benz Stadium, Atlanta, GA.
The match was the last friendly match for the USMNT before the final squad selection for the 2026 FIFA World Cup.
The result marked the second consecutive defeat for the USMNT that week.
The USMNT lost 5-2 to Belgium days before March 31, 2026.
Before the match, the head-to-head history slightly favored the US over Portugal in historical duels.
The US and Portugal had a famous 3-2 match in the 2002 World Cup.
